brief.subject: Woven rope segment body — two twisted strands, vanilla-leather brown
brief.gameplayMeaning: Block texture for the 2px-wide rope column placed on solid blocks, fences and walls; only a 2x16 horizontal slice is visible in the model, so the weave must read at any 2px-wide vertical strip
visualPriority: first read as a twisted two-strand rope at native 16x16
then keep the diagonal weave visible inside a 2px-wide slice
remain consistent with the knot (rope_knot) and rope_lantern textures

mustHave: two-strand twist pattern with light and dark strand separation
horizontally repeating weave so a 2px slice still reads as rope
mustNotHave: high-contrast outline that would read as a solid bar
